method: The release author published each Server-win-x64.zip on GitHub. The official asset digest matched the downloaded archive, which contained only RTServer.exe. SHA256 and length were measured on each executable. All three old tags have byte-identical Source/Server/PacketManagers/PM_Market.cs (SHA256 225beb172bf3ec5d6cf4fc2d22839131f82b9f8787710fdd059d8d59b9247250): OnRemove finds a listing in Master.MarketFile.Entries by its Identifier and removes it. The new server uses a different on-disk listing format.
scope: These identities select the old market reader for sellers to withdraw listings. They do not certify a completed player trade.
